profesionales.hero.image_alt: Renovation under way with electrical, plasterboard and painting work
profesionales.hero.body: Work with AHOMED if you are a renovator, builder, interior designer or property manager. Electrical work, plumbing, painting, plasterboard, blinds, cameras, gardening and final cleaning, with a single point of contact and a written quote.
profesionales.why.title: I don't want to take your client. I want to take work off your plate.
profesionales.why.body: A job drags on when three or four different trades have to be coordinated. AHOMED covers trades such as electrical work, plumbing, painting, plasterboard and final cleaning, with a single point of contact and clear dates.
profesionales.modelos.title: Three ways to collaborate
profesionales.modelos.body: It's not all or nothing. Choose the model that best fits your business — or combine them.
profesionales.modelos.item1.title: 1. Commission per referred client
profesionales.modelos.item1.body: You introduce us to a client and, if the project goes ahead, you receive a commission on our margin or a fixed amount per closed project. The simplest way to start.
profesionales.aporta.title: What AHOMED covers on your project
profesionales.aporta.body: The services that are almost always needed in a renovation or a home about to be handed over. One point of contact for all of them.
profesionales.piloto.title: First trial job, no commitment
profesionales.piloto.body: The easiest way to start collaborating, before discussing any formal agreement.
profesionales.piloto.item1.title: 1. You introduce us to a client
profesionales.piloto.item1.body: You spot the opportunity in a job you already have underway.
profesionales.piloto.item4.title: 4. If it goes well, we make it ongoing
profesionales.piloto.item4.body: We turn the first job into a stable collaboration, with the model that fits best.
profesionales.final.title: Shall we talk about collaborating?
profesionales.final.body: Tell us what kind of projects you do and which trades are hardest for you to cover. We will prepare a tailored collaboration proposal — no obligation.
servicios.hero.subtitle: Everything we do, organised by what you need and with one point of contact. Call or message us: the technical visit is free and the quote is given in person.
servicios.final_cta.title: Can't find the service you need?
servicios.final_cta.body: If what you need is not listed here, message me and we will talk it through: tell me what it is and I will say whether I can help. If you are working on a renovation or construction project, see AHOMED for Professionals.

home.services.title: Repair, renovate, protect and maintain your home
home.services.subtitle: Simple, well-done jobs for your home or business, organised by what you need and with a single point of contact. Free technical visit and a no-obligation quote.
profesionales.why.card1.title: One contact for several trades
profesionales.why.card1.body: Instead of calling an electrician, a painter, a plasterboard fitter and a cleaning company, you talk to one person who organises the work.
profesionales.why.card2.title: Your client stays yours
profesionales.why.card2.body: You present the job and keep the client relationship. AHOMED does its part, leaves it clean and coordinates with you.
profesionales.why.card3.title: Clear quote and deadlines
profesionales.why.card3.body: Written quote after the visit, deadline agreed before we start and no surprises at the end.
profesionales.modelos.item2.title: 2. You subcontract a trade
profesionales.modelos.item2.body: You include the electrical, painting or plasterboard part in your quote and we carry it out with a written quote. You keep running the job and the client relationship.
profesionales.modelos.item3.title: 3. Clean handover and finishing touches
profesionales.modelos.item3.body: When you finish, we take care of the finishing touches and the final construction cleaning so you hand over the home ready to live in.
profesionales.piloto.item2.title: 2. We visit and make the proposal
profesionales.piloto.item2.body: We look at the job and prepare the quote.
profesionales.piloto.item3.title: 3. We coordinate with your team
profesionales.piloto.item3.body: We agree dates with your team so we do not get in the way of other trades.
sobre_mi.areas.item1: Electrical work: panels, sockets, lighting and faults
sobre_mi.areas.item2: Painting of homes and commercial premises
faq.q1.a: Free first technical visit, at your home or business. We look at the job, take measurements and explain your options; then we give you a detailed written quote, with no obligation and no small print.
faq.q2.a: It depends on the job, the materials and the condition of your home, so we don't quote prices without seeing it: two homes that look the same from the outside can need very different work. During the free technical visit we look at it with you and give you a detailed quote, item by item, with no obligation.
faq.q3.a: No. You pay for the job once. Security cameras record on your own equipment, with no fee or lock-in. The only recurring service is monthly garden maintenance, which is optional and also has no lock-in.
faq.q5.q: How long does a job take?
faq.q5.a: It depends on the service: from a quick job of a couple of hours (a few sockets, a WiFi camera) to several days for painting a whole flat or a large construction clean-up. The exact time is agreed at the technical visit.
faq.q6.q: What guarantee do the jobs have?
faq.q6.a: Every job comes with a written guarantee, stated in the accepted quotation and on the invoice. The workmanship guarantee lasts {meses} months from delivery and covers defects in the work carried out; equipment and materials also keep their legal and manufacturer guarantees. It does not cover misuse, normal wear or work by third parties. If anything comes up, message us on WhatsApp with a photo and we will take a look.
faq.q7.q: Can I order several jobs at once?
faq.q7.a: Yes, and it usually works out better: for example, plasterboard + electrical work + painting + final cleaning in a renovation. With a single contact the trades are coordinated and waiting between them is avoided.
faq.q8.q: Do I supply the materials or do you?
faq.q8.a: Usually we do, and you see it itemised in the quote. If you prefer to buy something yourself — for example the spotlights, a blind motor or the paint — we deduct it and only take care of installing it.
faq.q9.q: Do you also work with shops, communities or warehouses, or only homes?
faq.q9.a: With all kinds of spaces: flats, houses, shops, offices and communal areas. The quote is adjusted to the size and type of job after the visit.
faq.q10.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.q10.a: By phone call or WhatsApp, whichever is easier for you. The first technical visit is free with no obligation.
faq.q11.q: How are the cameras different from an alarm with a monthly fee?
faq.q11.a: There is no fee. An alarm with a monitoring centre usually comes with a monthly fee and almost always a lock-in of up to 24 months: if you leave, you keep nothing. With AHOMED cameras you pay for the installation once, with no lock-in, and the equipment is yours. One caveat: it is not an alarm monitoring centre — nobody watches the footage for you; you watch it from your phone or review it whenever you need.
